subject: Hygiene Development
content: School cleanliness means keeping your classroom, playground, and school compound clean. Put rubbish in dustbins, not on the floor. Keep your desk and area tidy. During sanitation time, help sweep the classroom or pick up litter. Do not write or draw on desks or walls. Keep the toilet clean and wash your hands after using it. A clean school helps everyone stay healthy and learn better. When you help keep your school clean, you show pride in your school and respect for your classmates and teachers.
summary: School cleanliness: put rubbish in bins, keep desk tidy, help sweep, keep toilet clean. Clean school = healthy students and pride.
learning_objectives: Learn how to keep school clean
nigerian_examples: Participating in weekly sanitation time at school
Using dustbins placed around the school compound
Forming cleaning groups to take turns tidying the classroom

quiz_questions.question: Where should you put rubbish at school?
quiz_questions.explanation: Always put rubbish in dustbins to keep the school clean.

quiz_questions.question: What should you do during sanitation time?
options: Help sweep or pick up litter
quiz_questions.correct_answer: Help sweep or pick up litter
quiz_questions.explanation: Sanitation time is when everyone works together to clean the school.

quiz_questions.question: Why should you keep the school toilet clean?
options: So everyone can use it without getting sick
So you don't have to wash hands
quiz_questions.correct_answer: So everyone can use it without getting sick
quiz_questions.explanation: Clean toilets prevent germs from spreading and keep everyone healthy.

quiz_questions.question: What shows pride in your school?
quiz_questions.explanation: Taking care of your school shows you are proud to be a student there.

quiz_questions.question: True or False: Only teachers are responsible for school cleanliness.
quiz_questions.explanation: Everyone — students, teachers, and staff — is responsible for keeping the school clean.
